reviewNature: Owner-authorized AI-assisted review under AGENTS.md (2026-10-13). Not an independent human review; no certification or conformance is claimed.

components.name: Next.js web application (pages, embeds, API routes)
components.runtime: Render web service srv-dbp9png8v5cc73dkk830 (free plan), Node.js 22, unprivileged user
components.trustBoundary: Internet-facing; same-origin check on every cookie-authenticated mutation; security headers and CSP from next.config.ts

components.name: Neon Auth (managed Better Auth) sessions
components.runtime: Neon Auth for project cool-dawn-42333373; Google sign-in
components.trustBoundary: Third-party identity provider; the app trusts verified sessions and binds administrators to immutable subject IDs (PLATFORM_ADMIN_USER_IDS)

components.name: PostgreSQL (Neon)
components.runtime: Neon project cool-dawn-42333373, production branch br-tiny-haze-bdurpbbb
components.trustBoundary: TLS connection with credentials from DATABASE_URL; append-only evidence tables and authorization re-checked by triggers

components.name: S3-compatible media bucket
components.trustBoundary: Private bucket; signed URLs for owner uploads and released downloads; objects bound to SHA-256 digests

components.name: Operator-laptop malware scanner (ClamAV)
components.runtime: Docker on the platform operator's computer; outbound only; not running unless started by the operator
components.trustBoundary: Authenticated pull with a paired bearer token (timing-safe comparison); verdicts bound to lease and digest

components.name: Hosted ClamAV image (paid, not deployed)
components.runtime: Not deployed (billing deferred by the owner)
components.trustBoundary: Same verdict contract as the laptop scanner

components.name: FFmpeg summary render worker (not deployed)
components.runtime: Not deployed; would need a paid always-on worker
components.trustBoundary: Reads approved source objects, writes derivative candidates that need exact-output approval

components.name: Outbox delivery (email provider and signed webhooks)
components.runtime: Runs in the web process after the queuing action, or from the admin button / manual GitHub workflow; no email provider or webhook destination configured
components.trustBoundary: Outbound HTTPS only; DNS answers vetted against non-public ranges before connecting; HMAC-signed bodies; no redirects; size and time caps

components.name: Manual GitHub Actions operations trigger
components.trustBoundary: GitHub OIDC token bound to repository ID, workflow path, ref and audience; optional OPERATIONS_RUN_TOKEN

components.name: Optional AI assistant and transcription
components.runtime: Not configured in production (no DEBATE_ASSISTANT_* or NEON_AI_GATEWAY_* keys)
components.trustBoundary: Private, consent-gated, owner-scoped; output never public

components.name: Read-only public API, RSS, sitemap, embeds and press kits
components.trustBoundary: Reads only published rows; no account IDs, emails, drafts, assistant output or verification evidence

components.name: GitHub Actions CI, CodeQL, dependency audit and registry sync
components.trustBoundary: contents: read except the registry sync; no production credentials in CI

dataFlows.rationale: Authentication is delegated to the identity provider

dataFlows.protection: HTTPS; owner-scoped presigned parts; server re-hash; malware verdict before publication
dataFlows.rationale: Server-side scanning and public publication require plaintext

dataFlows.data: Scan jobs, object bytes and verdicts
dataFlows.protection: HTTPS; paired bearer token; lease- and digest-bound verdicts
dataFlows.rationale: The scanner must read the bytes

dataFlows.data: All records, including private drafts and audit events
dataFlows.protection: TLS; least-privilege queries; triggers re-check authorization and immutability
dataFlows.rationale: Server must process records; see F3 for the open E2EE decision

dataFlows.data: Notices and invitations to verified destinations
dataFlows.protection: HTTPS; SSRF-vetted addresses; HMAC signatures; CR/LF stripped
dataFlows.rationale: Delivery to third-party mailboxes and endpoints the candidate verified

dataFlows.protection: GitHub OIDC with repository, workflow, ref and audience pinning; forced key refresh throttled

dataFlows.data: Consented private media or text for analysis
dataFlows.protection: Not configured; consent and owner scoping when enabled
dataFlows.rationale: Only with explicit consent; provider choice would need review

dataFlows.data: Published debates, feeds, embeds, press kits

limitations: The inventory and its review are AI-assisted, not an independent expert review; external review remains pending follow-up.
Coverage is of this repository's source, build and deployment configuration; the internals of Neon, Render, the identity provider and any future email or AI provider are out of scope.
Two flows (F3 private drafts and F9 assistant analysis) are candidates for end-to-end encryption; the owner has not decided whether drafts move to local or E2EE storage.
Workers marked not deployed (hosted scanner, render worker) were reviewed in source only.
